census.note: latest 2026-09; The U.S. deficit with Mexico widened by $10.8 bn from September 2025. Imports from Mexico changed +17.7 bn (+39.6%) and U.S. exports +6.9 bn (+25.2%). Main drivers: vehicles and parts (-3.4 bn); computers and machinery (-3.0 bn). Partly offset by mineral fuels (oil, gas, refined) (+0.9 bn).
